title: ASC Transport Envelope v0.1
description: Transport wrapper for an ASC Write Contract v0.1. T-010 (D-029): issued_at/expires_at lifetime <= 30 minutes and a SHA-256 digest over canonical JSON of {envelope_version, request_id, issued_at, expires_at, contract} are enforced server-side by transport/envelope-security.mjs. The digest is integrity/error detection only, not sender authentication. Security metadata does not change semantic contract meaning.
